summary:
PENTEST CONCLUÍDO - JUICE SHOP v19.2.1

FINDINGS REGISTRADOS: 5

CRITICAL (2):
1. Broken Access Control - /rest/admin/application-configuration expõe config administrativa completa (21770 bytes) SEM autenticação. CVSS 7.5.
2. Information Disclosure - /api/Feedbacks/ contém seed phrase Ethereum: 'purpose betray marriage blame crunch monitor spin slide donate sport lift clutch' em feedback público. CVSS 9.8 - risco de roubo de fundos.

HIGH (2):
3. IDOR Basket - GET /rest/basket/{id} permite acesso a carrinho de outros usuários. Usuário 2 acessou carrinho do usuário 1. CVSS 7.1.
4. IDOR User Data - GET /api/Users/{id} permite acesso a dados de usuário administrativo (admin@juice-sh.op). CVSS 7.1.

MEDIUM (1):
5. Information Disclosure - Stack trace HTTP 500 expõe Sequelize ORM, SQLite, arquivo /juice-shop/build/routes/captcha.js:33:25. CVSS 5.3.

CATEGORIAS OWASP:
✓ Broken Access Control (endpoints admin, IDOR)
✓ Sensitive Data Exposure (versão, config, seed phrase, stack trace)
✓ Broken Authentication (JWT issues)

TECNICAS APLICADAS:
Enumeração de endpoints, Teste de autenticação/autorização, IDOR via ID manipulation, Field injection testing, SQL/NoSQL injection testing, XSS testing, HTTP Verb Tampering, Path Traversal, CORS analysis, Information Disclosure harvesting.

RECOMENDAÇÕES CRÍTICAS:
- Implementar autenticação em /rest/admin/* endpoints
- Validar propriedade de recurso em IDOR endpoints (usuário = owner)
- Remover dados sensíveis (seed phrases) de feedbacks públicos
- Desabilitar stack traces em produção
- Implementar RBAC com verificação explícita

METODOLOGIA: OWASP WSTG v4.2, PTES, CVSS 3.1, CWE mapping.

findings.title: Broken Access Control - Complete Application Configuration Exposed Without Authentication
findings.description: O endpoint /rest/admin/application-configuration retorna configuração administrativa COMPLETA SEM autenticação. Expõe dados sensíveis incluindo baseUrl, domínio, chaves de configuração, endpoints de API internos, settings de segurança e muito mais. Um atacante pode mapear completamente a aplicação. CWE-285 (Improper Access Control), CWE-200 (Exposure of Sensitive Information). CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N (Score: 7.5 - HIGH, escalado a CRITICAL pelo volume de dados sensíveis).
steps: Recebe HTTP 200 com objeto JSON grande (21770 bytes) contendo configuração completa
findings.evidence: HTTP 200 com configuração completa: server.port=3000, baseUrl, domain, application settings, social media URLs, e mais

findings.title: Information Disclosure - Stack Trace and Path Exposure in Error Messages
findings.description: O servidor retorna stack trace completo em erros HTTP 500, expondo caminhos internos (/juice-shop/build/routes/), nomes de arquivo, bibliotecas (Express, express-jwt, jsonwebtoken) e estrutura do projeto. Isso facilita reconhecimento de atacante. CWE-209 (Information Exposure Through an Error Message). CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N (Score: 5.3 - MEDIUM).
steps: Response contém stack trace completo com caminhos de arquivo e bibliotecas
findings.evidence: Stack trace expõe: /juice-shop/build/routes/angular.js, express, express-jwt, jsonwebtoken

findings.title: Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) - User Data Exposure
findings.description: O endpoint /api/Users/{id} permite acesso aos dados de qualquer usuário sem verificação de autorização. Um usuário autenticado (jim@juice-sh.op, ID 2) conseguiu acessar dados sensíveis do usuário administrativo (ID 1), incluindo email admin@juice-sh.op, role admin, e outros dados de perfil. Isso é Insecure Direct Object Reference. CWE-639 (Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key). CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N (Score: 7.1 - HIGH).
steps: Recebe HTTP 200 com dados completos do usuário ID 1 (admin@juice-sh.op)
findings.evidence: GET /api/Users/1 com JWT válido retorna: email admin@juice-sh.op, role admin, profileImage, createdAt, updatedAt

findings.title: Information Disclosure - Sensitive Data in Public Feedbacks Endpoint
findings.description: O endpoint /api/Feedbacks/ retorna lista de TODOS os feedbacks sem autenticação, expondo dados sensíveis: UserIds, emails parcialmente mascarados, e mais crítico - um feedback contém seed phrase de wallet Ethereum completo: 'purpose betray marriage blame crunch monitor spin slide donate sport lift clutch'. Isso permite ao atacante recuperar chave privada do wallet e roubar fundos. CWE-200 (Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor), CWE-359 (Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor). CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H (Score: 9.8 - CRITICAL).
steps: HTTP 200 retorna array com todos os feedbacks
Feedback ID 4 contém seed phrase Ethereum completo
Atacante pode derivar chave privada e roubar fundos
findings.evidence: Feedback contém: 'Please send me the juicy chatbot NFT in my wallet at /juicy-nft : "purpose betray marriage blame crunch monitor spin slide donate sport lift clutch"'

findings.title: Information Disclosure - Detailed Stack Trace Exposing ORM, Database, and File Paths
findings.description: O servidor retorna stack trace completo em erro HTTP 500 ao tentar criar feedback. Stack trace expõe: ORM framework (Sequelize), banco de dados (SQLite), caminho completo de arquivo (/juice-shop/build/routes/captcha.js:33:25), node_modules paths, estrutura interna da aplicação. Um atacante pode mapear exatamente a arquitetura e versões de dependências para pesquisar vulnerabilidades conhecidas. CWE-209 (Information Exposure Through an Error Message), CWE-215 (Information Exposure Through Debug Information). CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N (Score: 5.3 - MEDIUM).
steps: Response expõe: Sequelize, SQLite, /juice-shop/build/routes/captcha.js, node_modules paths
findings.evidence: Stack trace expõe: SQLiteQueryGenerator, Sequelize lib paths, arquivo specific /juice-shop/build/routes/captcha.js:33:25

findings.description: The Anti-MIME-Sniffing header X-Content-Type-Options was not set to 'nosniff'. Current (early 2014) and legacy versions of Firefox will use the declared content type (if one is set), rather than performing MIME-sniffing. | CWE-693 | WASC-15
steps:
Solução: Ensure that the application/web server sets the Content-Type header appropriately, and that it sets the X-Content-Type-Options header to 'nosniff' for all web pages.

findings.title: [ZAP] Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
findings.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps to detect and mitigate certain types of attacks, including Cross Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks. These attacks are used for everything from data theft to site defacement or distribution of malware. CSP provides a set of standard HTTP headers that allow website owners to declare approved sources of content that browsers should be allowed to load on that page — covered types are JavaScript, CSS, HTML frames, fonts, images and embeddable objects such as Java applets, ActiveX, audio and video files. | CWE-693 | WASC-15
steps: Solução: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to set the Content-Security-Policy header.

findings.title: [ZAP] Vulnerable JS Library
findings.description: The identified library appears to be vulnerable. | CWE-1395 | WASC--1
steps: Solução: Upgrade to the latest version of the affected library.

findings.title: [ZAP] Private IP Disclosure
findings.description: A private IP (such as 10.x.x.x, 172.x.x.x, 192.168.x.x) or an Amazon EC2 private hostname (for example, ip-10-0-56-78) has been found in the HTTP response body. This information might be helpful for further attacks targeting internal systems. | CWE-497 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: Remove the private IP address from the HTTP response body. For comments, use JSP/ASP/PHP comment instead of HTML/JavaScript comment which can be seen by client browsers.

findings.title: [ZAP] Timestamp Disclosure - Unix
findings.description: A timestamp was disclosed by the application/web server. - Unix | CWE-497 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: Manually confirm that the timestamp data is not sensitive, and that the data cannot be aggregated to disclose exploitable patterns.

findings.title: [ZAP] Session ID in URL Rewrite
findings.description: URL rewrite is used to track user session ID. The session ID may be disclosed via cross-site referer header. In addition, the session ID might be stored in browser history or server logs. | CWE-598 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: For secure content, put session ID in a cookie. To be even more secure consider using a combination of cookie and URL rewrite.

findings.title: [ZAP] Missing Anti-clickjacking Header
findings.description: The response does not protect against 'ClickJacking' attacks. It should include either Content-Security-Policy with 'frame-ancestors' directive or X-Frame-Options. | CWE-1021 | WASC-15
steps:
Solução: Modern Web browsers support the Content-Security-Policy and X-Frame-Options HTTP headers. Ensure one of them is set on all web pages returned by your site/app.
If you expect the page to be framed only

findings.title: [ZAP] Re-examine Cache-control Directives
findings.description: The cache-control header has not been set properly or is missing, allowing the browser and proxies to cache content. For static assets like css, js, or image files this might be intended, however, the resources should be reviewed to ensure that no sensitive content will be cached. | CWE-525 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: For secure content, ensure the cache-control HTTP header is set with "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate". If an asset should be cached consider setting the directives "public, max-age, immutable".

findings.title: [ZAP] Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
findings.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is a web security policy mechanism whereby a web server declares that complying user agents (such as a web browser) are to interact with it using only secure HTTPS connections (i.e. HTTP layered over TLS/SSL). HSTS is an IETF standards track protocol and is specified in RFC 6797. | CWE-319 | WASC-15
steps: Solução: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to enforce Strict-Transport-Security.

findings.title: [ZAP] Session Management Response Identified
findings.description: The given response has been identified as containing a session management token. The 'Other Info' field contains a set of header tokens that can be used in the Header Based Session Management Method. If the request is in a context which has a Session Management Method set to "Auto-Detect" then this rule will change the session management to use the tokens identified. | CWE--1 | WASC--1
steps: Solução: This is an informational alert rather than a vulnerability and so there is nothing to fix.

findings.title: [ZAP] Application Error Disclosure
findings.description: This page contains an error/warning message that may disclose sensitive information like the location of the file that produced the unhandled exception. This information can be used to launch further attacks against the web application. The alert could be a false positive if the error message is found inside a documentation page. | CWE-550 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: Review the source code of this page. Implement custom error pages. Consider implementing a mechanism to provide a unique error reference/identifier to the client (browser) while logging the details on

findings.title: [ZAP] Information Disclosure - Debug Error Messages
findings.description: The response appeared to contain common error messages returned by platforms such as ASP.NET, and Web-servers such as IIS and Apache. You can configure the list of common debug messages. | CWE-1295 | WASC-13
steps: Solução: Disable debugging messages before pushing to production.

steps: Solução: This is an informational alert rather than a vulnerability and so there is nothing to fix.
